summary: The note describes a wellness workshop series launched by Local Health and Wellness on September 15, 2023, blending mindfulness with AI to manage stress in a tech-saturated world. Led by Evelyn Tranquille and Dr. Hugo Reinhardt, the sessions use biometric wearables, the AI guide SerenAI, and technologies like microgravity pods and VR. Themed events run from the opening "Neuro-Nirvana" through to a December 1, 2023 "Synaptic Symposium".
one_line: Local Health and Wellness launched an AI-assisted mindfulness workshop series from September 2023, led by Evelyn Tranquille and Dr. Hugo Reinhardt, to combat tech-related stress.
key_facts: Local Health and Wellness launched a series of wellness workshops on September 15, 2023.
The inaugural event was titled "Neuro-Nirvana" and was spearheaded by mindfulness expert Evelyn Tranquille and stress expert Dr. Hugo Reinhardt.
In "Neuro-Nirvana", attendees wear biometric wearables to track heart rate variability and brainwave activity.
"SerenAI" is a virtual AI guide that analyses brain activity to give real-time mindfulness guidance.
The fourth session, on October 20, 2023, taught stress relief tactics, including AI-assisted deep breathing synced to holographic visuals and neurofeedback sessions.
Dr. Reinhardt introduced the stress relief tactics, which were backed by evidence-based research and tailored to individuals by AI.
Evelyn Tranquille leads "Interstellar Intersection", somatic workshops using microgravity simulation pods to create a feeling of weightlessness.
"Harmonics of the Heart", a sonic therapy workshop, starts November 3, 2023, using AI-composed symphonies that adapt to the participant's emotional state.
In "Harmonics of the Heart", Dr. Reinhardt explains binaural beats and isochronic tones, and earbuds read neural cues to transmit frequencies promoting deep relaxation.
"Quantum Quandary" challenges participants to maintain meditative states during random shifts in time perception created by AI time-bending technology.
The "Synaptic Symposium" is set for December 1, 2023, where participants use virtual-reality headsets to share thoughts and experiences in a cybernetic space.
The series is also referred to as the "Mindfulness in the Era of Artificial Intelligence" series and treats AI as part of a holistic approach to wellness.
